full_text_zh:
[P1] 围魏救赵

[P2] 战国时期有一位著名的谋略家——鬼谷子王诩，他收了两个徒弟，一个名叫庞涓，一个名叫孙膑。

庞涓学成以后，到魏国做了大将军。他嫉妒孙膑比他聪明，用计让孙膑失去了双脚。孙膑装疯逃出魏国后，到齐国受到重用，成为一位神机妙算的军师。

[P3] 公元前 354年，庞涓率领魏军出征赵国，想一举吞并赵国。他战无不胜，很快就打到了赵国的都城邯郸，把小小的邯郸城围得严严实实。
"不好了，我们的粮草被魏军烧了！"
"砰！"一块石头从天而降，在邯郸的城墙上砸出一个大窟窿。

[P4] 赵国国君带兵苦守邯郸城。
可是庞涓用兵如神，烧了赵
军的粮草，还造出了攻城利
器——投石车。
眼看邯郸就要守不住了，赵
国国君赶忙写了一封信，派
人送到了齐国："邯郸被围，
请求支援！"

[P5] 如果赵国被魏国打败了，庞涓会不会乘胜追击打到齐国来？齐威王很担心，他召集谋士商量后，决定出兵救邯郸。齐威王想请孙膑担任主将，可是孙膑看着自己的双腿，叹息道：‘我不能和将士们一起上阵杀敌，做不了主将呀！但是，我可以帮主将出主意，击退魏军！’于是，齐威王让田忌将军做了主将，孙膑随军一起出发，援助赵国。

[P6] 田忌挠挠头，闹不明白："魏军就要打进邯郸了，这个时候怎么会主动退兵呢？"

田忌打算带兵直奔邯郸城，击退魏军，救下赵国。
孙膑却连连摇头说："丝线缠在一起，硬拽是解不开的；两个人打架，旁人也不能冲进去胡乱出拳。要想救邯郸，咱们得抓住魏国的要害，让他们自己退兵。"

[P7] 孙膑胸有成竹地说：“庞涓把军队带去打邯郸，魏国的都城大梁只剩下些老弱残兵。如果我们现在直攻大梁，庞涓一定会退兵回来救援，这样邯郸不就得救了吗？

孙膑的计策让田忌心服口服，他立即下令，大军直奔魏国都城大梁。”

[P8] 魏国的士兵很快就发现了齐军的行踪，赶紧向魏惠王报告。这时候的大梁城里，老弱残兵加在一起也不到两万人，怎么能抵挡齐军的进攻呢？
此时此刻，打下邯郸要紧，还是保住大梁重要？

[P9] 魏惠王心中当然最清楚，大梁是魏国的国都，绝对不能有闪失。十万火急，他立刻派人去传令，要庞涓快快带兵返回魏国。身在赵国的魏军连续几天都没有好好休息，一直在攻城，现在听说自己的国都被齐军包围了，他们慌得连武器、粮草都顾不上多带，就不分白天黑夜地往回赶。

[P10] 当庞涓带着魏军走到桂陵时，忽然，周围响起了震耳欲聋的喊杀声。一群群兵马从山上冲下来，杀向又累又困的魏军。原来，孙膑早就在这里埋伏了千军万马，魏军日夜赶路的时候，齐军原地休息，只等着魏军钻进他们设好的圈套。

[P11] 魏军被杀得丢盔弃甲，死伤无数。最后，庞涓只带着少数的残兵败将逃回了大梁。齐军包围了魏国的都城大梁，魏军不得不从赵国撤了兵，这样就解救了邯郸城。这个计策就叫“围魏救赵”。

[P12] 公元前341年，魏惠王派庞涓带兵攻打韩国。韩国也像赵国一样，急忙来向齐国求救，齐王还是派了田忌和孙膑这对搭档出兵救援。

[P13] 田忌边走边问孙膑："先生，这回咱们用什么办法对付庞涓呢？"孙膑说："田将军，魏国平时根本看不起齐国，庞涓这个人也骄傲自大。这回，咱们还是用‘围魏救赵’的老办法对付他，你看行不行？"田忌高兴地说："好，那咱们就先攻打魏国，等庞涓回去再收拾他。"

[P14] 庞涓正在攻打韩国，忽然，传令兵带着魏王的命令来了："庞将军，齐军又来打大梁了，大王让您赶快撤兵赶回去！"庞涓明明知道这还是孙膑上次用过的老办法，可是魏王的命令不能违抗啊，他赶紧带领魏军往回赶。

[P15] 谁知道，庞涓刚刚到达魏国的领地，就接到了新消息："齐军已经撤回齐国去了！"
庞涓听了又气又急，恨得牙痒痒，他高声喊了起来："追，给我追！"

[P16] 两次中了孙膑的“围魏救赵”之计，
庞涓气急败坏。
只是他没有想到，这一追
却又第三次掉进了孙膑的
圈套，他也因此送了命。
当然，那就是另一个故事
了。
full_text_en:
[P1] Surround Wei to Rescue Zhao

[P2] During the Warring States period, there was a famous strategist—Guiguzi Wang Xu, who took on two disciples: one named Pang Juan, and the other named Sun Bin.

After mastering his skills, Pang Juan went to the State of Wei and became a general. Jealous that Sun Bin was smarter than him, he plotted to have Sun Bin lose his legs. After pretending to be mad and escaping from Wei, Sun Bin was highly valued in the State of Qi and became a brilliant and resourceful military commander.

[P3] In 354 BC, Pang Juan led the Wei army to campaign against the State of Zhao, aiming to annex it entirely. Invincible in battle, he quickly reached Zhao's capital, Handan, and tightly besieged the small city.
"Oh no! Our supplies have been burned by the Wei army!"
"Bang!" A stone fell from the sky, smashing a huge hole in the walls of Handan.

[P4] The King of Zhao led his troops in a desperate defense of Handan.
But Pang Juan, with his brilliant military tactics, burned Zhao's supplies and built a siege weapon—the trebuchet.
Seeing that Handan was about to fall, the King of Zhao hurriedly wrote a letter and sent it to the State of Qi: "Handan is under siege, please send reinforcements!"

[P5] If Zhao were defeated by Wei, would Pang Juan then pursue and attack Qi? King Wei of Qi was very worried. After consulting with his advisors, he decided to send troops to rescue Handan. King Wei wanted to appoint Sun Bin as the commander, but Sun Bin, looking at his own legs, sighed: 'I cannot fight alongside the soldiers on the battlefield; I can't be the commander! But I can help the commander with strategies to defeat the Wei army!' Thus, King Wei appointed General Tian Ji as the commander, while Sun Bin joined the army to assist in rescuing Zhao.

[P6] Tian Ji scratched his head, puzzled: "The Wei army is about to break into Handan. How could they possibly retreat on their own at this moment?"

Tian Ji planned to lead his troops straight to Handan City, defeat the Wei army, and rescue the State of Zhao.
Sun Bin, however, shook his head repeatedly and said: "When threads are tangled together, pulling hard won't untie them; when two people fight, a bystander can't rush in and start swinging wildly. To save Handan, we must strike at the vital point of the State of Wei, forcing them to retreat on their own."

[P7] Sun Bin said confidently, "Pang Juan has taken his army to attack Handan. The capital of Wei, Daliang, is left with only old and weak soldiers. If we attack Daliang directly now, Pang Juan will surely retreat to rescue it. Wouldn't that save Handan?"

Sun Bin's strategy convinced Tian Ji. He immediately gave the order: the army would march straight for the capital of Wei, Daliang.

[P8] The soldiers of the State of Wei quickly discovered the movements of the Qi army and hurried to report to King Hui of Wei. At this moment, inside the city of Daliang, the old and weak soldiers combined numbered less than 20,000—how could they possibly resist the attack of the Qi army?
At this critical moment, is it more important to capture Handan, or to protect Daliang?

[P9] King Wei of Wei knew perfectly well that Daliang, the capital of Wei, could not be left in danger. In a state of extreme urgency, he immediately sent messengers to order Pang Juan to quickly return with his troops to Wei. The Wei soldiers, who had been attacking the city in Zhao for several days without proper rest, were now panicked upon hearing that their own capital had been surrounded by the Qi army. In their haste, they barely took time to gather weapons and supplies, rushing back day and night.

[P10] When Pang Juan led the Wei army to Guiling, suddenly, deafening shouts of battle erupted from all around. Waves of troops charged down from the mountains, attacking the exhausted and weary Wei soldiers. It turned out that Sun Bin had already hidden a massive force here. While the Wei army marched day and night, the Qi army rested in place, waiting for the Wei troops to fall into their carefully laid trap.

[P11] The Wei army was routed, losing their armor and weapons, with countless casualties. In the end, Pang Juan fled back to Daliang with only a small number of surviving soldiers. The Qi army surrounded the Wei capital, Daliang, forcing the Wei army to withdraw from Zhao. This rescued the city of Handan. This strategy is called "Surround Wei to Rescue Zhao."

[P12] In 341 BC, King Wei of Wei sent Pang Juan to lead troops in attacking the state of Han. Like Zhao, Han hurriedly sent a plea for help to Qi. King Qi once again sent the duo Tian Ji and Sun Bin to lead the army in rescue.

[P13] Tian Ji asked Sun Bin as they walked: "Master, what strategy should we use this time to deal with Pang Juan?" Sun Bin replied: "General Tian, the State of Wei has always looked down on Qi, and Pang Juan himself is arrogant and overconfident. This time, let’s use the old strategy of ‘surrounding Wei to rescue Zhao’ to deal with him. What do you think?" Tian Ji happily responded: "Good! Then let’s first attack Wei, and wait until Pang Juan returns to deal with him."

[P14] Pang Juan was attacking the State of Han when suddenly, a messenger arrived with the King of Wei's order: "General Pang, the Qi army is attacking Daliang again. The King commands you to withdraw your troops and return immediately!" Pang Juan clearly knew this was the same old tactic Sun Bin had used before, but he couldn't disobey the King's command. He hurriedly led his Wei army back.

[P15] Who would have thought, just as Pang Juan arrived at the borders of the State of Wei, he received news: "The Qi army has already retreated back to Qi!"
Pang Juan, furious and desperate, gritted his teeth and shouted: "Chase them! Pursue them!"

[P16] Having fallen for Sun Bin's 'Besiege Wei to Rescue Zhao' strategy twice, 
Pang Juan was furious and desperate.
But he didn't realize that this pursuit 
would lead him into Sun Bin's trap for the third time, 
and thus cost him his life.
Of course, that is another story.
full_summary_zh:
[P1] 本页标题为“围魏救赵”，画面描绘了一位坐在战车上的将领，身后有士兵和写有“齐”字的旗帜，暗示齐国军队出征的场景。
[P2] 本页介绍了战国时期谋略家鬼谷子王诩的两位徒弟庞涓和孙膑，并讲述了庞涓因嫉妒孙膑而陷害他，孙膑装疯逃到齐国后成为军师的故事。
[P3] 本页描绘了公元前354年庞涓率魏军攻打赵国都城邯郸的场景，魏军围城严密，赵国士兵惊慌失措，城墙上被投石机砸出大洞，粮草被烧，形势危急。
[P4] 画面描绘了赵国都城邯郸被魏军围攻的危急场景，城池被投石车轰击，粮草被焚，赵国国君在城墙上焦急万分，遂向齐国求援。
[P5] 齐威王担忧赵国被魏国攻破后会威胁齐国，决定出兵救援邯郸。他想任命孙膑为主将，但孙膑因腿疾自认无法上阵，只愿出谋划策，最终齐威王任命田忌为将，孙膑随军出征，共同援助赵国。
[P6] 齐国将领田忌计划直接率军救援被围困的赵国都城邯郸，但军师孙膑提出不同策略，主张不直接与魏军硬碰硬，而是应攻击魏国的要害，迫使魏军自行撤退。
[P7] 孙膑向田忌提出‘围魏救赵’的计策，建议不直接救援被围困的邯郸，而是攻打魏国都城大梁，迫使庞涓回师救援。田忌采纳此计，立即下令大军直奔大梁。
[P8] 魏国士兵发现齐军逼近大梁，向魏惠王报告，城内兵力空虚，魏惠王陷入是否应撤军回救大梁的两难抉择。
[P9] 魏惠王得知齐军围攻魏国都城大梁，立即下令庞涓率军回援，魏军因惊慌而仓促撤退，连武器粮草都来不及多带。
[P10] 齐军在桂陵设伏，趁魏军疲惫之际发动突袭，孙膑的计策成功实施，魏军陷入混乱。
[P11] 齐军在桂陵伏击魏军，大获全胜，庞涓率残兵败将逃回大梁，魏军被迫从赵国撤兵，邯郸得以解围，孙膑的“围魏救赵”计策成功。
[P12] 公元前341年，魏惠王派庞涓攻打韩国，韩国向齐国求救，齐王再次派遣田忌和孙膑出兵救援。
[P13] 田忌向孙膑请教如何对付庞涓，孙膑建议再次采用‘围魏救赵’的计策，田忌欣然同意，决定先攻打魏国，待庞涓回师后再予以打击。
[P14] 庞涓在攻打韩国时，接到魏王命令，称齐军围攻大梁，命其立即撤兵回援。尽管他识破这是孙膑的计策，但因无法违抗王命，只得带领魏军仓促回撤。
[P15] 庞涓刚回到魏国边境，得知齐军已撤回齐国，气急败坏地命令追击。
[P16] 本页描绘了庞涓两次中计后气急败坏，却不知自己正第三次落入孙膑的圈套，最终将因此丧命，故事暗示后续将有新的篇章展开。
